column1: # One or more rows per *_IMAGE variable of versions.env. Columns, tab separated:
# see tests/smoke/README.md. scripts/ci/image-smoke.sh runs the rows.

column5: expect

column4: minimap2 -d mini.mmi /in/mini.fa && minimap2 -t 4 -a -x sr -R '@RG\tID:HG002\tSM:HG002\tPL:ILLUMINA\tLB:HG002' mini.mmi /in/reads_R1.fq.gz /in/reads_R2.fq.gz > sr.sam && minimap2 -t 4 -a -x map-hifi /in/mini.fa /in/long.fq.gz > long.sam
column5: at_least "short reads mapped (%)" "$(mapped_pct sr.sam)" 95; at_least "long reads mapped (%)" "$(mapped_pct long.sam)" 95

column4: samtools sort -@ 2 -m 500M -o s.bam /in/mini.bam && samtools index s.bam && samtools quickcheck -v s.bam && samtools view -C -T /in/mini.fa -o s.cram s.bam && samtools index s.cram && samtools view -c s.bam > n_bam.txt && samtools view -c -T /in/mini.fa s.cram > n_cram.txt && samtools faidx /in/mini.fa chr20:1001-1100 > sub.fa && samtools flagstat s.bam > flagstat.txt
column5: at_least "records in the sorted BAM" "$(cat n_bam.txt)" 50000; same "records after a BAM to CRAM round trip" "$(cat n_cram.txt)" "$(cat n_bam.txt)"; same "bases in a faidx region" "$(grep -v "^>" sub.fa | tr -d "\n" | wc -c)" 100

column4: bcftools view -Ob -o a.bcf /in/sample.vcf.gz && bcftools index a.bcf && bcftools view -Oz -o b.vcf.gz a.bcf && bcftools index -t b.vcf.gz && bcftools view -H b.vcf.gz | wc -l > n.txt && bcftools +split-vep -l /in/sample.vcf.gz > csq.txt && bcftools norm -m-both -f /in/mini.fa -Oz -o norm.vcf.gz /in/truth.vcf.gz && bcftools isec -n=2 -w1 -Oz -o shared.vcf.gz /in/truth.vcf.gz /in/query90.vcf.gz && bcftools view -H shared.vcf.gz | wc -l > shared.txt
column5: same "records after a VCF to BCF to VCF round trip" "$(tr -d " " < n.txt)" "$(grep -vc "^#" "$FX/HG002_vep.vcf")"; contains "split-vep lists the CSQ fields" csq.txt "Consequence"; same "records isec finds in truth and query" "$(tr -d " " < shared.txt)" "$(vcf_records /in/query90.vcf.gz)"; at_least "records after norm" "$(vcf_records norm.vcf.gz)" 300
at_least "SNV recall against the GIAB truth" "$(snv_recall dv.vcf.gz)" 0.95; same "sample column" "$(bcf query -l dv.vcf.gz)" HG002

column4: fastp -i /in/reads_R1.fq.gz -I /in/reads_R2.fq.gz -o t_R1.fq.gz -O t_R2.fq.gz --detect_adapter_for_pe --qualified_quality_phred 20 --cut_front --cut_tail --cut_mean_quality 20 --length_required 36 -g -R HG002 -j fastp.json -h fastp.html
column5: py "trimmed reads kept (at least 80 %)" "import json; s = json.load(open('fastp.json'))['summary']; b = s['before_filtering']['total_reads']; a = s['after_filtering']['total_reads']; print(a, 'of', b); assert b > 0 and a >= 0.8 * b"

column4: bwa-mem2 index -p mini /in/mini.fa && bwa-mem2 mem -t 4 -o bwamem2.sam -R '@RG\tID:HG002\tSM:HG002\tPL:ILLUMINA\tLB:HG002' mini /in/reads_R1.fq.gz /in/reads_R2.fq.gz
column5: at_least "reads mapped (%)" "$(mapped_pct bwamem2.sam)" 95

column4: bwa index -p mini /in/mini.fa && bwa mem -t 4 -R '@RG\tID:HG002\tSM:HG002' mini /in/reads_R1.fq.gz /in/reads_R2.fq.gz > bwa.sam
column5: at_least "reads mapped (%)" "$(mapped_pct bwa.sam)" 95
at_least "SNV recall against the GIAB truth" "$(snv_recall freebayes.vcf)" 0.9
at_least "SNV recall against the GIAB truth" "$(snv_recall strelka/results/variants/variants.vcf.gz)" 0.9
at_least "SNV recall against the GIAB truth" "$(snv_recall octopus.vcf.gz)" 0.9

at_least "SNV recall against the GIAB truth (synthetic HiFi reads)" "$(snv_recall clair3/merge_output.vcf.gz)" 0.8; contains "the ONT model directory step 03e uses" models.txt "^/opt/models/r1041_e82_400bps_sup_v500$"; contains "the HiFi model directory step 03e uses" models.txt "^/opt/models/hifi_revio$"
at_least "records at the planted deletion" "$(sv_near tiddit.vcf)" 1

column1: # Sniffles skips contigs shorter than 1 Mb unless told otherwise; the mini reference is 503 kb.

column5: at_least "records at the planted deletion" "$(sv_near sniffles.vcf)" 1

between "SNP recall of a query missing every tenth truth SNV" "$(csv_cell happy.summary.csv Type=SNP,Filter=PASS METRIC.Recall)" 0.85 0.95; at_least "SNP precision of that query" "$(csv_cell happy.summary.csv Type=SNP,Filter=PASS METRIC.Precision)" 0.99
at_least "records at the planted deletion" "$(sv_near manta/results/variants/diploidSV.vcf.gz)" 1
at_least "records at the planted deletion" "$(sv_near delly.bcf)" 1
at_least "CNVpytor calls overlapping the planted deletion" "$(awk '{split($2, a, /[:-]/); if (a[1] == "chr20" && a[2] <= 453000 && a[3] >= 450001) n++} END {print n + 0}' calls.tsv)" 1

column1: # GRIDSS (Java) looks up the container's hostname, which resolves only with a network.

column5: at_least "records at the planted deletion" "$(sv_near gridss.vcf.gz)" 1
between "DHFFC of the planted deletion (no reads)" "$(vcf_field duphold.vcf planted DHFFC)" 0 0.3; at_least "DHFFC of the control deletion (normal depth)" "$(vcf_field duphold.vcf control DHFFC)" 0.7
contains "AnnotSV starts and prints its options" help.txt "SVinputFile"; contains "the bundled bedtools runs" bedtools.txt "^bedtools v"
at_least "annotated SV lines" "$(awk 'NR > 1' annotsv.tsv | wc -l)" 10; at_least "lines with a gene name" "$(tsv_count annotsv.tsv Gene_name .)" 1
has "STR_STATUS of HTT at 19/45 repeats" "$(vcf_field stranger.vcf HTT STR_STATUS)" "full_mutation"; has "STR_STATUS of ATXN3 at 22/24 repeats" "$(vcf_field stranger.vcf ATXN3 STR_STATUS)" "^normal"

same "records kept" "$(grep -vc '^#' merged.vcf)" 1; same "support of the deletion called 2 bp apart" "$(awk -F'\t' '!/^#/ && $2 >= 10100999 && $2 <= 10101001 {n = split($8, i, ";"); for (k = 1; k <= n; k++) if (i[k] ~ /^SUPP=/) print substr(i[k], 6)}' merged.vcf)" 2

column4: vep --input_file /in/sample50.vcf --output_file vep.vcf --vcf --database --assembly GRCh38 --symbol --force_overwrite --no_stats && grep -v "^#" vep.vcf | awk -F'\t' '{n = split($8, kv, ";"); for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (kv[i] ~ /^CSQ=/) {k = split(substr(kv[i], 5), e, ","); for (j = 1; j <= k; j++) {split(e[j], f, "|"); m = split(f[2], q, "&"); for (x = 1; x <= m; x++) print $1 "\t" $2 "\t" $4 "\t" $5 "\t" q[x]}}}' | LC_ALL=C sort -u > csq.tsv && cat csq.tsv
column5: same "records with a CSQ annotation" "$(grep -v "^#" vep.vcf | grep -c "CSQ=")" 50; contains "a gene symbol of the fixture in CSQ" vep.vcf "CYP2C19|CYP2C9|SNAP25|HLA-"; at_least "variant and consequence pairs" "$(wc -l < csq.tsv)" 50; same "pairs that differ from tests/smoke/vep50_consequences.tsv" "$( { [ -s "${SMOKE_DIR}/vep50_consequences.tsv" ] || echo "< the baseline file is missing"; diff csq.tsv "${SMOKE_DIR}/vep50_consequences.tsv"; } 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^[<>]")" 0

has "cpsr --version names the release line of the image tag (2.3.2 says cpsr 2.3.0)" "$(cat cpsr_version.txt)" "cpsr $(echo "${PCGR_IMAGE##*:}" | cut -d. -f1-2)"; same "records the bundled VEP annotates" "$(grep -v "^#" vep.vcf | grep -c "CSQ=")" 50; has "the pcgrr R package is the release of the image tag" "$(cat pcgrr_version.txt)" "^${PCGR_IMAGE##*:}"; same "flags of step 17 that cpsr --help does not list" "$(grep -c . cpsr_missing_flags.txt)" 0
at_least "genes with a named diplotype in report.json" "$(pharmcat_called HG002.report.json)" 1
has "CYP2D6 genotype" "$(cat CYP2D6.genotype.txt)" "^\*[0-9]"

same "intratelomeric reads (1,100 planted)" "$(tsv_cell th/HG002/HG002_summary.tsv intratel_reads)" 1100; between "tel_content of the planted reads (5594.23 with 1.1.0 and with the earlier image)" "$(tsv_cell th/HG002/HG002_summary.tsv tel_content)" 5594 5595; between "TCAGGG per intratelomeric read (100 of 1,100)" "$(tsv_cell th/HG002/HG002_summary.tsv TCAGGG_arbitrary_context_norm_by_intratel_reads)" 0.09 0.092
has "haplogroup" "$(tsv_cell haplogroup.txt Haplogroup)" "^[A-Z]"; at_least "haplogroup quality" "$(tsv_cell haplogroup.txt Quality)" 0.8
has "contamination status" "$(tsv_cell haplocheck.txt 'Contamination Status')" '^(YES|NO|ND)$'; at_least "homoplasmies counted" "$(tsv_cell haplocheck.txt 'Overall Homoplasmies')" 1

has "a Y haplogroup, or NA (insufficient markers)" "$(tsv_cell yleaf/hg_prediction.hg Hg)" '^([A-T]|NA$)'; at_least "Y markers with haplogroup information" "$(tsv_cell yleaf/hg_prediction.hg Valid_markers)" 1

has "HLA-A allele, one of HG002's (A*01:01, A*26:01)" "$(awk -F'\t' '$1 == "HLA-A" {print $3}' t1k/HG002_hla_genotype.tsv)" "^HLA-A\*(01:01|26:01)"; has "both HLA-A alleles of HG002 (A*01:01 and A*26:01)" "$(awk -F'\t' '$1 == "HLA-A" {print $3, $6}' t1k/HG002_hla_genotype.tsv)" "^HLA-A\*01:01[^ ]* HLA-A\*26:01|^HLA-A\*26:01[^ ]* HLA-A\*01:01"

py "the bundled GRCh38 catalog has at least 20 loci" "import json; n = len(json.load(open('bundled_catalog.json'))); print(n); assert n >= 20"; py "a genotype for the repeat on the fixture" "import json; v = json.load(open('eh.json'))['LocusResults']['SMOKE1']['Variants']['SMOKE1']; print(v.get('Genotype')); assert v.get('Genotype')"
at_least "sample rows in the .ped" "$(awk '!/^#/ && NF >= 6' indexcov/indexcov-indexcov.ped | wc -l)" 1
at_least "mean depth on chr20" "$(awk '$1 == "chr20" {print $4}' md.mosdepth.summary.txt)" 15

column1: # Zenodo data (homology table and models, ~50 MB) is downloaded in the row, as setup.sh --parascopy-data does.

column5: at_least "rows of the SMN1/SMN2 profile" "$(grep -vc '^#' smn.tsv)" 1; py "an aggregate copy number of the SMN1/SMN2 region, with its quality" "import csv; rows = [r for r in csv.reader(open('smn.tsv'), delimiter='\t') if r and not r[0].startswith('#')]; print(rows); assert any(r[0] == 'chr5' and r[6] not in ('', '*') and r[7] not in ('', '*') for r in rows)"

same "sample read from @RG SM" "$(tsv_cell rel.samples.tsv sample_id)" HG002; at_least "sites genotyped (of 90 autosomal sites)" "$(awk -F'\t' 'NR == 1 {for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) c[$i] = i; next} {print $c["n_hom_ref"] + $c["n_het"] + $c["n_hom_alt"]; exit}' rel.samples.tsv)" 60; at_least "mean depth at the genotyped sites" "$(tsv_cell rel.samples.tsv gt_depth_mean)" 15; same "no sex call from 2 chrX sites" "$(tsv_cell rel.samples.tsv sex)" -9

contains "with the sanity check, 320 markers are refused" checked.result "Insufficient Available markers"; between "FREEMIX of the clean HG002 slice" "$(tsv_cell vb.selfSM FREEMIX)" 0 0.03; same "panel size in the selfSM" "$(tsv_cell vb.selfSM SNPS)" 320
at_least "SNV recall against the GIAB truth" "$(snv_recall gatk.vcf.gz)" 0.9

column4: java -Xmx2g -jar /usr/picard/picard.jar LiftoverVcf I=/in/truth.vcf.gz O=lift.vcf.gz CHAIN=/in/identity.chain R=/in/mini.fa REJECT=rejected.vcf.gz WARN_ON_MISSING_CONTIG=true
column5: same "records lifted over an identity chain" "$(vcf_records lift.vcf.gz)" "$(vcf_records /in/truth.vcf.gz)"

same "Cyrius installed from the hash-locked file" "$(cat installed.txt)" "cyrius ${CYRIUS_VERSION}"; same "the TSV has a row for the sample" "$(tsv_cell HG002_cyp2d6.tsv Sample)" HG002_cyrius; py "Cyrius read depth from the BAM (median depth above 0)" "import json; d = json.load(open('HG002_cyp2d6.json'))['HG002_cyrius']; print('median depth', d['Median_depth'], 'MAD', d['Coverage_MAD'], 'genotype', d['Genotype']); assert float(d['Median_depth']) > 0"
between "score sum over five ALT alleles of weight 1" "$(tsv_cell score.sscore SCORE1_SUM)" 5 10

column1: # pgsc_calc's images (steps 25 and 26). pgscatalog-format writes the custom GRCh38 file step 25's prs-format makes as pgsc_calc's first step does; the other commands pgsc_calc calls must exist.

column4:
printf '#pgs_id=PGS000001
#pgs_name=PGS000001
#trait_reported=Test trait
#genome_build=GRCh38
chr_name	chr_position	effect_allele	other_allele	effect_weight
20	10050000	A	G	0.5
20	10057919	C		1
' > s.txt && mkdir fmt && pgscatalog-format -s s.txt -t GRCh38 -o fmt && { for f in fmt/*; do gzip -dc "$f" 2>/dev/null || cat "$f"; done; } > formatted.txt && ls fmt > fmt_files.txt && for c in combine match intersect aggregate ancestry-adjust; do pgscatalog-$c --help > help-$c.txt 2>&1; done
column5: contains "pgscatalog-format kept the row without an other allele" formatted.txt "10057919"; contains "pgscatalog-format kept the accession of the custom header" formatted.txt "PGS000001"; contains "pgscatalog-match runs" help-match.txt "min_overlap"; contains "pgscatalog-ancestry-adjust runs" help-ancestry-adjust.txt "target_pcs"; contains "pgscatalog-intersect runs" help-intersect.txt "maf_target"

column4: fraposa --help > help.txt 2>&1; python -c 'import fraposa_pgsc; print(fraposa_pgsc.__version__)' > version.txt
column5: contains "fraposa lists the projection method pgsc_calc passes" help.txt "--method"; has "fraposa_pgsc is the release of the image tag" "$(cat version.txt)" "^${PGSC_FRAPOSA_IMAGE##*:v}"

column4: python -c 'import yaml, platform; print(yaml.safe_dump({"tool": ["pgsc_calc", platform.python_version()]}))' > v.yml
column5: contains "yaml writes the list pgsc_calc's version dump writes" v.yml "^- pgsc_calc$"

column1: # EXTRACT_DATABASE in pgsc_calc and setup.sh --ancestry-panel read the panel with these tar and zstd calls.

column4: mkdir d e && printf 'v0.1\n' > d/meta.txt && printf 'chr\n' > d/GRCh38_T_ALL.pvar && zstd -q d/GRCh38_T_ALL.pvar -o d/GRCh38_T_ALL.pvar.zst && tar -C d -cf - meta.txt GRCh38_T_ALL.pvar.zst | zstd -q -o p.tar.zst && (cd e && tar -xf ../p.tar.zst --wildcards 'GRCh38*' meta.txt) && tar -xOf p.tar.zst --wildcards 'GRCh38_*_ALL.pvar.zst' | zstd -dc > pvar.txt
column5: contains "tar -xf unpacks the zstd tar by name" e/meta.txt "^v0.1$"; nonempty "the GRCh38 member" e/GRCh38_T_ALL.pvar.zst; contains "tar -xO and zstd -dc read the .pvar as setup.sh does" pvar.txt "^chr$"
has "quarto, which renders pgsc_calc's report" "$(cat quarto.txt)" "^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"; contains "R runs" r.txt "^R version"
nonempty "the HTML report" mqc/multiqc_report.html; at_least "samtools data files naming HG002" "$(grep -l HG002 mqc/*_data/multiqc_samtools* 2>/dev/null | wc -l)" 1
at_least "records with a REVEL score" "$(grep -v "^#" vcfanno.vcf | grep -c "REVEL=")" 10
contains "compound-hets as step 31 calls it writes a VCF" step31.vcf "^#CHROM"; at_least "records in a compound-het pair" "$(grep -v "^#" comphet.vcf | grep -c "slivar_comphet=")" 2
